# Qualifying companies and amalgamation ¶20-150

Existing qualifying companies may still amalgamate in accordance with the provisions set out in s FO 3(2) (¶20-095).

If a company that is not a qualifying company amalgamates with a qualifying company and ceases to exist on the amalgamation, the amalgamated company must pay qualifying company election tax under s HA 40.

In addition, the tax losses of the amalgamating company are lost (s HA 23).

*Refs: s FO 3(2), s HA 40, s HA 23*

Law: IT07 ss FO 3(2), HA 23, HA 40

*Refs: ss FO 3(2)*
